markdown.name: Should this action check status effects

member.markdown: This means that this actions provides a status to the target. If that target already has the status provided by the selected, RSR will not cast it. Some statuses can be stacked together, like damage over time actions, and RSR will take that into account and only check if you are its source.

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Actions.ActionConfig.AutoHealRatio
member.summary: The heal ratio for the auto heal.

markdown.name: HP ratio for automatic healing

member.markdown:
The maximum HP percentage the target must be before at for this action to be considered in the rotation. If it is set to "80%", then it will not heal the target if they are at 81% HP. It will heal them at 80% and below. This setting works in conjunction with
Automatic Healing Thresholds .

member.name: T:RotationSolver.Basic.Actions.SpecialActionType
member.summary: Specific action type for the action.

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Actions.SpecialActionType.None
member.summary: No special movement behaviour.

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Actions.SpecialActionType.MeleeRangedAttack
member.summary: Ranged attack that can be used by a Melee class/job (e.g. Ranged attack fallback).

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Actions.SpecialActionType.FixedDistanceMoveForward
member.summary: A pure movement action that moves the character a fixed distance forward in the current facing/screen direction with no target requirement (e.g. En Avant, Elusive Jump, Hells Ingress, AetherialShiftPvE). Targeting uses area-move logic and the destination is validated for safety.

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Actions.SpecialActionType.FixedDistanceMoveBackward
member.summary: A pure movement action that moves the character a fixed distance forward in the current facing/screen direction with no target requirement (e.g. Hell's Regress). Targeting uses area-move logic and the destination is validated for safety.

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Actions.SpecialActionType.HostileMovingForward
member.summary: A non-damage targeted movement action that dashes to the hitbox of a hostile target (e.g. TrajectoryPvE on GNB). Targeting selects the best hostile target within range; destination is validated for safety.

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Actions.SpecialActionType.FriendlyMovingForward
member.summary: A targeted movement action that dashes to the hitbox of a friendly/party target (e.g. Aetherial ManipulationPvE targeting an ally). Targeting selects the best party member in range; destination is validated for safety.

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Actions.SpecialActionType.HostileFriendlyMovingForward
member.summary: A targeted movement action that can dash to either a hostile or friendly target depending on what is currently selected (e.g. AetherialManipulationPvP). Targeting prefers the focus/hard target; destination is validated for safety.

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Actions.SpecialActionType.HostileMovingAttack
member.summary: A movement-attack action where the movement is part of an offensive hit (e.g. Primal Rend on WAR, Dragonfire Dive on DRG, IntervenePvE on PLD). Targeting uses the standard hostile targeting pipeline with all normal filters (stop marks, priority, TTK, resistance). Position safety is still validated. Do not use pure movement target logic for these — the action must hit a valid enemy.

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.Configs.MeleeRangedOffset

markdown.name: 近战范围技能偏移使用

member.markdown:
近战职业使用远程攻击的额外缓冲距离（单位：星码）。例如， 若你游玩武士且此设置设为 `1`，则从 4 星码开始才会使用飞刃。
这是因为近战范围的默认"溢出"为 3 星码，意味着你可以在敌人判定圈外 3 星码处施放近战攻击。 此设置（偏移量）会取最大近战范围并加上你设置的值。
此设置的存在是为了让你有时间接近并进入敌人的近战范围，而不浪费 GCD。

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.Configs.SwiftcastBuffer

markdown.name: RSR 应在下一个 GCD 前多久使用 Swiftcast 进行复活

member.markdown: 如果你施放了一个 GCD 且冷却为 2.5 秒，当冷却开始时有队友死亡，Swiftcast 动作会在你的冷却结束前等待指定的时间 才施放 Swiftcast。这是为了防止过早使用 Swiftcast 而浪费，避免你的搭档治疗在你的全局冷却期间内成功复活你的目标。

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.Configs.RaiseDelay2

markdown.name: 复活玩家的随机延迟范围

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.Configs.HealthDifference

markdown.name: 使用 AoE 治疗的 HP 标准差

member.markdown: 控制队伍成员的 HP 必须相差多少才会使用 AoE 治疗而非单体治疗。 较低的值要求队伍成员的 HP 更接近才会触发 AoE 治疗（更挑剔）。 较高的值允许即使 HP 差异较大也使用 AoE 治疗（不那么挑剔）。 仅在你想要细调 AoE 治疗行为时调整。

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.Configs._action6head

markdown.name: 提前量

member.markdown:
在 GCD 周期中剩余的 GCD 时间百分比，达到此值时 RSR 会尝试排队下一个 GCD。
此设置控制 RSR 会尝试在单个 GCD 窗口中插入多少个 oGCD。 数值越小，oGCD 越多，但可能导致更多 GCD 卡顿。

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.Configs._removeAnimationLockDelay
member.summary: Remove extra lag-induced animation lock delay from instant casts (read tooltip!) Do NOT use with XivAlexander or NoClippy - this should automatically disable itself if they are detected, but double check first!

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.Configs.AnimationLockDelayMax2
member.summary: Animation lock max. simulated delay in milliseconds Configures the maximum simulated delay in milliseconds when using animation lock removal - this is required and cannot be reduced to zero. Setting this to 20ms will enable triple-weaving when using autorotation. The minimum setting to remove triple-weaving is 26ms. The minimum of 20ms has been accepted by FFLogs and should not cause issues with your logs.

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.Configs._removeCooldownDelay
member.summary: Remove extra framerate-induced cooldown delay Dynamically adjusts cooldown and animation locks to ensure queued actions resolve immediately regardless of framerate limitations

member.markdown:
**`建议每个补丁后点击重置按钮。`**
若仇恨列表中任意敌人正在施放列表中的技能,RSR 将使用群体减伤。 这些技能通常是范围攻击。

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.OtherConfiguration.HostileCastingTank

markdown.name: Tank Buster

member.markdown:
**`建议每个补丁后点击重置按钮。`**
若目标正在被列表中的技能锁定,RSR 将对目标(治疗)或自身(坦克)使用减伤。

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.OtherConfiguration.HostileCastingKnockback

markdown.name: Knockback

member.markdown:
**`建议每个补丁后点击重置按钮。`**
**点击"记录击退技能"需自行承担风险。某些副本需要你利用击退到达正确安全点, 例如西尔狄赫水道(零式)。**
当你将被列表中的技能击退时,RSR 会使用防击退技能。

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.OtherConfiguration.HostileCastingStop

markdown.name: Gaze/Stop

member.markdown:
**`建议每个补丁后点击重置按钮。`**
若目标正在施放列表中的技能,RSR 将在技能判定前数秒停止读条 此处。

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.OtherConfiguration.BeneficialPositions

markdown.name: Beneficial Positions

member.markdown:
添加一个偏好位置,用于地面**治疗** AoE 技能(例如:地星)。
你可以添加多个位置,以防 Boss 战将你转移到另一个平台,例如 M4S - 邪恶之雷。

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.OtherConfiguration.DangerousStatus

markdown.name: Dispellable Debuffs

member.markdown:
**`建议每个补丁后点击重置按钮。`**
列表中的状态将优先于其他可驱散状态被驱散(康复)。

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.OtherConfiguration.PriorityStatus

markdown.name: Priority

member.markdown:
**`建议每个补丁后点击重置按钮。`**
在自动模式下,若仇恨列表中任意敌人带有此状态,将优先将其作为目标。

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.OtherConfiguration.InvincibleStatus

markdown.name: Invulnerability

member.markdown:
**`建议每个补丁后点击重置按钮。`**
若目标带有列表中的状态,将被视为无敌并忽略。

member.name: F:RotationSolver.Basic.Configuration.OtherConfiguration.NoCastingStatus

markdown.name: No-Casting Debuffs

member.markdown:
**`建议每个补丁后点击重置按钮。`**
若你带有列表中的任意状态,RSR 将停止所有行动。

member.name: M:RotationSolver.Basic.DataCenter.IsMagicalDamageIncoming
member.summary: Determines whether any currently casting hostile action is classified as magical.
member.returns: True if at least one hostile target is casting an action whose AttackType.RowId == 5 (interpreted as magical); otherwise false.
member.remarks: Scans all hostile entities with a non-zero CastActionId, looks up the action row, and inspects the attack type. Returns early on the first confirmed magical cast. If the action sheet cannot be loaded or no valid casts exist, returns false.

member.name: M:RotationSolver.Basic.DataCenter.IsPhysicalDamageIncoming
member.summary: Determines whether any currently casting hostile action is classified as physical.
member.returns: True if at least one hostile target is casting an action whose AttackType.RowId == 7 (interpreted as physical); otherwise false.
member.remarks: Scans all hostile entities with a non-zero CastActionId, looks up the action row, and inspects the attack type. Returns early on the first confirmed magical cast. If the action sheet cannot be loaded or no valid casts exist, returns false.

member.name: T:RotationSolver.Basic.Data.TerritoryInfo
member.summary: Represents detailed information about a specific territory, including its name, identifier, and various attributes such as PvP status and content finder details.

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Data.TerritoryInfo.Name
member.summary: Gets the name of the territory.
member.remarks: The name represents the display name of the territory, extracted and processed to provide a user-friendly format. It may include localization depending on the underlying data.

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Data.TerritoryInfo.Id
member.summary: Gets the unique identifier of the territory.
member.remarks: The identifier is a numerical value that uniquely represents the territory within the data context. It is derived from the underlying sheet row identifier and is used for internal referencing and data mapping.

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Data.TerritoryInfo.IsPvP
member.summary: Indicates whether the territory is designated as a PvP (Player vs Player) zone.
member.remarks: This property reflects the PvP status of the territory as defined in the game data. A value of true signifies that the territory supports or is specifically intended for PvP activities, while a false value indicates that the territory does not include PvP content.

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Data.TerritoryInfo.ContentFinderName
member.summary: Gets the content finder name associated with the territory.
member.remarks: The content finder name represents a unique identifier or label used in the game's content finder system to categorize or display the content linked to the specific territory.

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Data.TerritoryInfo.IsHighEndDuty
member.summary: Indicates whether the territory is classified as a high-end duty.
member.remarks: This property reflects the high-end difficulty status of the associated content in the game, typically referring to challenging endgame activities or encounters.

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Data.TerritoryInfo.ContentType
member.summary: Gets the content type of the territory.
member.remarks: The content type categorizes the type of activities or gameplay associated with a specific territory. This property is derived from the content finder condition and provides information about the territory's primary function, such as whether it is related to a dungeon, raid, or open-world content.

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Data.TerritoryInfo.ContentFinderIcon
member.summary: Gets the identifier of the content finder icon associated with the territory.
member.remarks: The icon identifier corresponds to the visual representation used in-game for the content finder, providing a graphical indication of the type or status of the content associated with the territory. A default icon may be used if no specific icon is designated.

member.name: M:RotationSolver.Basic.Data.TerritoryInfo.#ctor(Lumina.Excel.Sheets.TerritoryType)
member.summary: Represents detailed information about a specific game territory. Contains attributes such as the territory's name, unique identifier, PvP status, content finder details, and whether it is classified as a high-end duty.

Creates a celestial ring 8 yalms around the caster. Snake Scales PvP (VPR) [39185] [Ability]
Grants Hardened Scales changing Snake Scales to Backlash. Hardened Scales Effect: Reduces damage taken by 50% and grants immunity to Stun Heavy Bind Silence Half-asleep Sleep Deep Freeze and knockback and draw-in effects Duration: 4s Additional Effect: Grants Armored Scales to self creating a barrier that nullifies damage equivalent to a heal of 4,000 potency Duration: 4s Grants Snake's Bane when barrier is completely absorbed. Waiting 4s or executing Backlash while under the effect of Hardened Scales delivers an attack with a potency of 12,000 to all enemies within 6 yalms. Range is increased to 15 yalms and potency is increased by 50% for enemies within 6 yalms while under the effect of Snake's Bane. Unable to move while under the effect of Hardened Scales.

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Rotations.CustomRotation.HasBuffs
member.summary:
Determines whether the player has any active buffs or the hostile target has any active debuffs from the predefined list of status effects.
This property first populates the list by calling to ensure it reflects the current party composition or player's job.
It checks for buffs on the player: if the player exists, it verifies that all buff-type statuses in are currently active on the player and not about to end.
It checks for debuffs on the hostile target: if a hostile target exists, it verifies that all debuff-type statuses in are currently active on the target and not about to end.
In the context of FFXIV rotation solving, this helps determine if beneficial status effects (buffs) are maintained on the player or if detrimental effects (debuffs) are applied to the target, influencing rotation decisions.
member.returns:
true if the player has all relevant buffs active (or if no player is present but buffs are defined) or if the hostile target has all relevant debuffs active; otherwise, false.
Note: Returns false if is empty after population.

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Rotations.CustomRotation.PartyBuffDuration
member.summary: Gets the duration (remaining time in seconds) of the status effect (buff or debuff) that will expire last among all active ones.

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Rotations.CustomRotation.Buffs
member.summary:
Gets the static list of status effects (buffs and debuffs) that are relevant to the current rotation configuration.
This list is populated by based on the party composition or the player's current job, and is used to track which status effects should be monitored for activation on the player (buffs) or hostile target (debuffs).

member.name: M:RotationSolver.Basic.Rotations.CustomRotation.StatusList
member.summary:
Populates the list with status effects (buffs and debuffs) based on the current party composition or the player's job.
This method clears any existing entries in and rebuilds the list to reflect the jobs present in the party or the solo player's job.
If is null (indicating a solo scenario), it adds buffs specific to the player's current job abbreviation.
If is available, it iterates through each party member's job and adds relevant buffs, avoiding duplicates via a processed jobs set.
The method is called for each unique job abbreviation to append appropriate entries to .
This ensures that contains only the status effects pertinent to the current group setup.

member.name: M:RotationSolver.Basic.Rotations.CustomRotation.GetCurrentMitigationPercent
member.summary: Calculates the current cumulative mitigation percentage applied to an imminent AoE or raid-wide hit.
member.returns: A normalized mitigation fraction in the range 0.0–0.95 (e.g. 0.25 == 25% damage reduction). The value is capped at 0.95 to prevent extreme stacking edge cases.
member.remarks:
Mitigations and enemy debuffs are applied multiplicatively as damage factors (e.g. 10% reduction = * 0.90). The function:
Scans hostile targets once for Addle, Feint, and Dismantle.
Scans party members for active raid/party-wide mitigation statuses (e.g. Sacred Soil, Temperance, Troubadour).
Handles mixed scaling for effects whose value differs by damage school (e.g. Addle, Feint, Dark Missionary).
Performance impact is minimal given normal FFXIV party sizes.

member.name: T:RotationSolver.Basic.Tweaks.AnimationLockTweak
member.summary: Effective animation lock reduction tweak (a-la xivalex/noclippy). The game handles instants and casted actions differently: * instants: on action request (e.g. on the frame the action button is pressed), animation lock is set to 0.5 (or 0.35 for some specific actions); it then ticks down every frame some time later (ping + server latency, typically 50-100ms if ping is good), we receive action effect packet - the packet contains action's animation lock (typically 0.6) the game then updates animation lock (now equal to 0.5 minus time since request) to the packet data so the 'effective' animation lock between action request and animation lock end is equal to action's animation lock + delay between request and response this tweak reduces effective animation lock by either removing extra delay completely or clamping it to specified min/max values * casts: on action request animation lock is not set (remains equal to 0), remaining cast time is set to action's cast time; remaining cast time then ticks down every frame some time later (cast time minus approximately 0.5s, aka slidecast window), we receive action effect packet - the packet contains action's animation lock (typically 0.1) the game then updates animation lock (still 0) to the packet data - however, since animation lock isn't ticking down while cast is in progress, there is no extra delay this tweak does nothing for casts, since they already work correctly The tweak also allows predicting the delay based on history (using exponential average).

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Tweaks.AnimationLockTweak.DelayAverage
member.summary: Gets the smoothed delay between client request and server response.

member.name: P:RotationSolver.Basic.Tweaks.AnimationLockTweak.DelayEstimate
member.summary: Gets a conservative estimate of the delay to use for animation lock reduction. Returns if animation lock delay removal is enabled; otherwise, returns 1.5 times the smoothed delay average, clamped to a maximum of 0.1 seconds.

member.param: Expected sequence number for the action

member.returns: Animation lock reduction amount

member.name: T:RotationSolver.Basic.Tweaks.CooldownDelayTweak
member.summary: Framerate-dependent cooldown reduction. Imagine game is running at exactly 100fps (10ms frame time), and action is queued when remaining cooldown is 5ms. On next frame (+10ms), cooldown will be reduced and clamped to 0, action will be executed and it's cooldown set to X ms - so next time it can be pressed at X+10 ms. If we were running with infinite fps, cooldown would be reduced to 0 and action would be executed slightly (5ms) earlier. We can't fix that easily, but at least we can fix the cooldown after action execution - so that next time it can be pressed at X+5ms. We do that by reducing actual cooldown by difference between previously-remaining cooldown and frame delta, if action is executed at first opportunity.

member.summary: If > 0 while using an action, cooldown/animation lock will be reduced by this amount as if action was used a bit in the past

member.summary: Start adjustment calculation based on previous conditions

member.summary: Stop the current adjustment

member.summary: Calculate the adjustment value based on previous conditions
